name: Jacob, deceiving Isaac for the blessing
charge: Putting on his brother's raiment and the skins of the kids, and saying to his blind father, I am Esau thy firstborn
summary: The word had been given before either child was born: two nations are in thy womb, and the elder shall serve the younger. Esau afterwards sold the birthright for a meal and despised it. When Isaac, whose eyes were dim, sent Esau for venison to bless him, Rebekah dressed Jacob in his brother's clothes with kid skins on his hands and neck and sent him in with the meat. He said he was Esau, took the blessing, and had to leave the country. He served twenty years for a father in law who changed his wages ten times, and was given the elder daughter in place of the younger.
offense: The outcome was settled before the act and before the men. The Lord told Rebekah, two nations are in thy womb, and two manner of people shall be separated from thy bowels, and the one people shall be stronger than the other people, and the elder shall serve the younger (Genesis 25:23).
